tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, OCC Web Services, database performance tuning, and agile workflows. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer holding a valid German residence and work permit, currently serving notice.

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Composable Storefront (Spartacus) Consultant
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior SAP Composable Storefront Consultant position at Senovo IT Ltd. With over 5 years of professional backend and e-commerce experience building and extending large enterprise platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, adhering strictly to platform best practices.

bullets.label: Headless APIs & OCC
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, alongside customized Interceptors and Converters.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Flows
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep enterprise catalogs synchronized.

bullets.label: Platform Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, customized Backoffice components, and managed platform releases through the Hybris Admin Console.

cover_en.gap: While my core expertise is rooted in SAP Commerce Cloud backend development, OCC REST APIs, and headless data flows rather than Angular-based Spartacus frontend implementations, I am very keen to learn and expand my skill set in composable storefront frameworks.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving notice with a last working day of 15.12.2026 and an earliest start date of 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application further.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to join Senovo IT Ltd to contribute my extensive SAP Commerce Cloud backend experience gained at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am excited by the opportunity to apply my strong background in OCC REST APIs, headless integrations, and enterprise e-commerce platforms to support your clients and technical initiatives.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, Java, and headless API integration experience from enterprise projects to your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am interested in the Senior SAP Composable Storefront Consultant role. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, strong Java and OCC API skills, I have applied with my CV. I hold a valid German work permit and am available from Dec 16, 2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior SAP Composable Storefront (Spartacus) Consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Composable Storefront Consultant position. With over 5 years of backend e-commerce experience specializing in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and OCC APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute to your projects.

I possess a valid German work permit and am available to start from 16.12.2026 following my notice period.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
